name: cluster_attributes
description: Manages DuploCloud AI Helpdesk cluster attributes — add-ons and components installed onto an existing EKS cluster (autoscaler, ALB controller, EFS, external-dns, and more).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this cluster attributes resource.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the cluster attributes resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: ID of the cluster baseline this resource configures.

attributes.name: cluster_name
attributes.description: Name of the cluster. Inherited from the linked cluster baseline.

attributes.name: vpc_id
attributes.description: VPC ID for the cluster. Inherited from the linked cluster baseline.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: AWS region. Inherited from the linked cluster baseline.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs for the cluster. Inherited from the linked cluster baseline.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: components
attributes.description: Cluster components to install.

attributes.name: cluster_autoscaler
attributes.description: Install the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler.

attributes.name: secret_csi_driver
attributes.description: Install the AWS Secrets Store CSI driver.

attributes.name: alb_load_balancer_controller
attributes.description: Install the AWS ALB/NLB load balancer controller.

attributes.name: efs_volumes
attributes.description: Install the Amazon EFS CSI driver for persistent volumes.

attributes.name: metrics_server
attributes.description: Install the Kubernetes Metrics Server.

attributes.name: kube_state_metrics
attributes.description: Install Kube State Metrics for cluster-level monitoring.

attributes.name: flux_cd
attributes.description: Install Flux CD for GitOps-based continuous delivery.

attributes.name: external_dns
attributes.description: Install ExternalDNS to manage Route53 records automatically.

attributes.name: external_dns_config
attributes.description: Configuration for ExternalDNS. Takes effect when components.external_dns is true.

attributes.name: provider
attributes.description: DNS provider (e.g. aws).

attributes.name: sources
attributes.description: Kubernetes resource types ExternalDNS should watch (e.g. ["service", "ingress"]).

attributes.name: policy
attributes.description: DNS sync policy (upsert-only or sync).

attributes.name: txt_owner_id
attributes.description: TXT record owner ID for tracking ExternalDNS-managed records.

attributes.name: domain_filters
attributes.description: Domain name filters restricting which hosted zones ExternalDNS manages.

attributes.name: eks_addons
attributes.description: EKS managed add-ons to install on the cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: EKS add-on name (e.g. vpc-cni, coredns, kube-proxy).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Add-on version. Defaults to the latest compatible version when unset.

attributes.name: config_values
attributes.description: JSON configuration values for the add-on.

attributes.name: service_account_role_arn
attributes.description: IAM role ARN for the add-on's service account (IRSA).

attributes.name: installed_eks_addons
attributes.description: EKS managed add-ons currently installed on the cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Add-on name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Installed version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Add-on installation status.

attributes.name: configuration_values
attributes.description: Configuration values applied to the add-on. Corresponds to config_values set in eks_addons.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: cf_stack_name
attributes.description: CloudFormation stack name for provisioned infrastructure.

attributes.name: installed_components
attributes.description: Components currently installed on the cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Component name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Installed version.

attributes.name: chart_version
attributes.description: Helm chart version.

attributes.name: namespace
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the component is deployed into.

attributes.name: iam_role_arn
attributes.description: IAM role ARN for the component's service account.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Installation status of this component.

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
